```{=html}
<style>
.w116-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w116-dd .w116-q {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w116-dd .w116-inputrow { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-top: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w116-dd input.w116-in {
  flex: 1; min-width: 200px; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); font-weight: 600;
}
.w116-dd input.w116-in.w116-right { border-color: #2e7d32; border-width: 2px; }
.w116-dd input.w116-in.w116-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; border-width: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d81e2e inset; }
.w116-dd .w116-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w116-dd .w116-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w116-dd .w116-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w116-dd .w116-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w116-dd .w116-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w116-dd .w116-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w116-dd .w116-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w116-dd iw" id="w116-dd">
  <div class="w116-q">
    In the data centre, a failed disk in the RAID array is replaced while the
    array continues to operate, so the storage system never stops serving.
    What is this practice called?
    <div class="w116-inputrow">
      <input type="text" class="w116-in" aria-label="your answer" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="type the term…">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w116-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w116-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w116-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w116-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w116-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w116-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w116-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Replacing a failed disk while the RAID array continues to run is called
    <em>hot swapping</em> (Comer, 2021, pp. 103–104): the array's redundancy carries
    the service through the failure, so the storage system never stops serving - see
    <a href="#sec-11-provider-redundancy">the section on the redundancy the provider
    builds in</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w116-dd');
  const input = root.querySelector('.w116-in');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w116-msg');
  // accepted if the normalised answer contains any of these
  const ACCEPT = ['hotswap', 'hotswapping'];
  const SOLUTION = 'hot swapping';

  function norm(s) { return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); }
  function clearMarks() {
    input.classList.remove('w116-right', 'w116-wrong');
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w116-msg iw-msg';
  }
  input.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
  input.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') check(); });

  function check() {
    input.classList.remove('w116-right', 'w116-wrong');
    const v = norm(input.value);
    if (v === '') {
      msg.textContent = 'Type an answer first - it is a two-word term from this chapter.';
      msg.className = 'w116-msg iw-msg';
      return;
    }
    if (ACCEPT.some(a => v.includes(a))) {
      input.classList.add('w116-right');
      msg.textContent = '✓ Correct - that is the term Comer uses for replacing a disk in a running array.';
      msg.className = 'w116-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else {
      input.classList.add('w116-wrong');
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not the term - re-read the section on the redundancy the provider builds in.';
      msg.className = 'w116-msg iw-msg bad';
    }
  }
  root.querySelector('.w116-check').addEventListener('click', check);
  root.querySelector('.w116-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    input.value = SOLUTION;
    input.classList.remove('w116-wrong');
    input.classList.add('w116-right');
    root.querySelector('.w116-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w116-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w116-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    input.value = '';
    root.querySelector('.w116-expl').hidden = true;
    clearMarks();
  });
})();
</script>
```
